TMB per Mb (PURPLE): Tumour mutational burden: passing variants per Mb (PURPLE tmbPerMb).
TMB Status (PURPLE): PURPLE TMB status: HIGH (> 10 per Mb), LOW or UNKNOWN.
TML (PURPLE): Tumour mutational load: missense variants (PURPLE tml).
TML Status (PURPLE): PURPLE TML status: HIGH, LOW or UNKNOWN.
HRD Score (CHORD): CHORD probability of homologous recombination deficiency.
HRD Type (CHORD): CHORD HRD type: BRCA1_type, BRCA2_type or none.
